events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start baseline work and secure plant access
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Confirm access to plant cost data and plant teams for the baseline work?
agenda: Present the engagement objective and the two phases
Discuss the cost data and plant contacts the baselines need
Confirm access to cost data and plant teams

events.label: Workshop 1: plant baselines
events.purpose: Review baselines and where cost arises
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Which loss causes should the improvement sizing detail first?
agenda: Present cost per part baselines for the six plants
Discuss loss causes and the estimated baselines
Decide which loss causes the sizing details first

events.label: Initiative go/no-go
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Go or no-go on the sized improvements, and which plant pilots them first?
agenda: Present the sized improvements by plant
Review the go/no-go case and the pilot plant options
Decide go or no-go and the pilot plant

events.label: Check-in: pilot change plan
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Confirm the pilot change plan as the basis for preparing the changes?
agenda: Present the pilot plant change plan
Discuss open points before preparation continues
Confirm the plan for preparing the pilot changes

events.label: Workshop 2: pilot and waves
events.purpose: Review pilot readiness and set rollout waves
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Which plants form wave 1 and wave 2 of the rollout after the pilot?
agenda: Review the pilot change plan and readiness record
Align on the cost per part measure for tracking savings
Decide wave 1 and wave 2 plants from sizing by plant

events.label: Check-in: wave 2 start
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Go or no-go on starting wave 2 at the planned plants, given the pilot savings?
agenda: Present the pilot go-live record and savings
Review how savings show in the cost data
Decide whether wave 2 starts as planned

events.label: Workshop 3: rollout results
events.purpose: Review results ahead of the final readout
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Which plant results and open points should the final readout detail?
agenda: Review pilot, wave 1 and wave 2 go-live records with cost per part
Align on how results are measured against each baseline
Decide which results and open points to detail

events.label: Final readout
attendees: Plant Directors of the six plants
events.decision: Approve the final results and the running improvements in all six plants?
agenda: Present cost per part by plant against its baseline
Review the final readout of results and running improvements
Decide on approval of the results and improvements
